disposition.note: Section 14 now names the owning catalogue of each of the six messages; English text unchanged. Thai wording stays with the owning catalogues under Program v5 DL10.

edits.old: The six message ids are contract elements and their text is the legacy and FSD wording, copied unchanged.
edits.new: The six message ids are contract elements. MSG-GEN-001 is the common set's message, MSG-P4-002 is the P4 catalogue's, MSG-P7-003 is the P7 catalogue's and MSG-P1-001 is the P1 catalogue's; each keeps the wording of its owning catalogue, copied unchanged. MSG-S5-001 and MSG-S5-002 are this module's own messages, from this module's catalogue (FSD S5 VR-S5-011-1 and VR-S5-009-1), and keep the legacy and FSD wording, copied unchanged.
